task_title: Stop caching mutable coordination docs and forward conditional writes

plan_review.notes: Blocking 1 (CAS methods must be optional instance fields, not prototype methods, or feature detection is always truthy) and blocking 2 (specified state machine: getWithETag must not populate the cache; putConditional success republishes via the put() serialization/token/epoch path; failure invalidates without publishing attempted bytes; offline rejects with zero inner calls) both adopted verbatim. Important 4 adopted: added a conditionalWrites capability because LocalRunStore implements both CAS methods but its stat-then-put is not atomic across processes, and saveThemeEquipmentSetState now fails loudly before writing when a shared azure-blob store reaches the non-atomic fallback. Important 5 adopted: both fixes shipped together since neither is independently sufficient. DIVERGENCE (minor) on important 3: reviewer wanted cacheability defaulted to non-cacheable with an opt-in immutable allow-list; shipped a centralized deny-list registry instead, because CachingRunStore.get() throws StoreNotFoundError for a non-cacheable key when offline, so inverting the default would silently break the documented CRAWLER_AZURE_OFFLINE=1 guarantee for every artifact. The registry requirement was honored: all four mutable coordination documents are registered in one module, and the two mutable-but-cacheable families (run summary.json, workflow-state/briefs) are audited and documented in place rather than left unexamined. Reviewer also recommended splitting the canvas UX fix into its own PR; the human explicitly directed one PR, so it is implemented last and confined to renderer.mjs.
